title: LS-MDRM Entropy Schema
description: Schema for recording and tracking the four-component entropy vector H_n = [H_s, H_g, H_r, H_c]_n across transitions.

H_s.description: Semantic entropy. Degree of semantic ambiguity or instability at this state.

H_g.description: Grounding entropy. Degree of evidence-binding weakness or absence at this state.

H_r.description: Recursive entropy. Degree of ancestry-chain weakness or rupture at this state.

H_c.description: Complexity entropy. Degree of evaluability difficulty at this state.

local_recovery_notes.description: If H_n > H_{n-1} followed by H_{n+k} < H_n, record that trajectory here. Local recovery does not reset ancestry. Null if not applicable.

recovery_requires.description: If recovery is claimed, states the conditions required: preserved recursive linkage and grounding. Null if no recovery asserted.

measurement_note: Entropy values use a normalized ordinal scale 0.0–1.0 derived from the diagnostic dimension scores. H_s ~ A/4; H_g ~ (4-G)/4; H_r ~ (4-P)/4; H_c ~ X/4. These mappings are definitional, not empirically calibrated. Do not collapse into a single scalar.
anti_collapse_rule: H_n must never be collapsed into one binary entropy result. All four components must be recorded independently.
